stem: Use suitable approximating distributions to answer the following.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: The random variable $W$ has the distribution $\text{B}(700, 0.005)$.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.stem: Two values of $W$ are chosen at random.
parts.text: Find the probability that the sum of these two values is less than 3.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The random variable $X$ has the distribution $\text{Po}(200)$.

Use a suitable approximating distribution to find $\text{P}(X > 205)$.
